tasks.short: Write grant proposals for external communications-research funding.

steps.what: Read the actual funding call and define the communications research question, method, contribution and feasible commitments
Develop and check actual research budget, work packages and supporting publication evidence
Write the proposal narrative from the chosen research argument, checked budget and actual evidence

loop.purpose: Draft proposal prose around the researcher's original scientific decisions.
loop.input: Actual call, chosen argument/method, verified publications, approved budget and commitments.
loop.output: Proposal draft with source links and explicit gaps.
loop.check: Teacher checks originality claims, method intent, feasibility, contribution, references and commitments against supplied evidence and call requirements.
loop.stop: One draft and correction; unsupported claims or missing research decisions return to manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native grant headings cannot express the study's contribution and methodological rationale.

steps.what: Check the exact completed proposal v1 for research fidelity, call compliance, budget consistency and authorised internal use
Save the exact checked research proposal v1 in the same internal project folder

tasks.design: Use native {SPREADSHEET} budget formulas and {DOCS} grant templates first, then a bounded draft over the teacher's own research argument and verified evidence. The teacher checks the generated meaning and completed proposal before saving it; institutional approval and external submission remain separate downstream work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Grant prose must connect original research choices to a particular call.
tasks.enabler_now: A constrained draft can rephrase explicit research decisions without making them.
tasks.still_hard: Original contribution, credible methods and funder fit remain research judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Own the research question and decide what can honestly be promised.

ambition.what: No new funding or submission authority.

tasks.altitude: Less first-draft prose and repeated budget setup; the same researcher accountability.

reach.learn: Tie deliverables to an actual method and approved resources.

evidence.claim: Source-constrained drafting and native budget formulas can assist proposal preparation; this is not a measured grant outcome.

assumptions: Boundary is writing the proposal, not institutional sign-off or funder submission. Those require exact final-package approval and separate actions if included. Shares are provisional.

Teacher produces actual question, method, rationale, deliverables, staffing effort and verified publications; finance supplies permitted rates and the funder supplies actual call text. Missing research or budget facts require manual authorship. Do not upload confidential third-party proposals or referee material; use only authorised sources.
Native configuration first. The 15% budget reduction is repeated formula/layout work only, with resource decisions and checks intact. No same-system save saving.
unknowns: Call-specific permitted use of drafting assistance
research_questions: Does reviewed drafting reduce rewriting without changing the research claim or commitments?

already_counted.description: Generated proposal meaning and reference checks.
Final call, budget and scientific-fidelity check.

incremental.description: Maintain call-specific draft and budget constraints.

approvals.approved_version: checked research proposal v1 for internal preparation; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A source-ready call permits 3 budget-setup hours and 14 prose hours to disappear per provisional 100 task hours, less 1.5 upkeep. A novel method leaves less reusable prose; research decisions, final review and save remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Listen to the student organisation's actual aims, editorial or event problem and constraints
Retrieve and check applicable student-organisation procedures and agreed prior actions
Give personal advice on the actual organisation issue, discuss choices and leave student decisions with the organisation
outputs: actual organisation advice and agreed follow-up

steps.what: Write and check the actual follow-up advice message v1 and its named student recipients
inputs: actual organisation advice and agreed follow-up

steps.what: Send the exact checked organisation advice message v1 to the named student recipients

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} links to current organisation procedures and actual prior advice. Personal listening and advice stay human, as do the actual follow-up message and its final-version check before the separate {EMAIL} send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advisers may repeatedly locate the same organisation procedures.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document tags and links can make those references easier to retrieve.
tasks.still_hard: Student relationships, editorial judgement and competing aims require discussion.
tasks.human_edge: Help students decide for themselves and recognise a sensitive issue.

ambition.what: No new authority over student organisations.

tasks.altitude: Less procedure search with the same advisory relationship.

reach.task: Help student media find reliable resources
reach.learn: Refer a specific information need without disclosing private student concerns.

evidence.claim: Native document links can reduce procedure retrieval without automating advice.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual advising and written follow-up/send, not organisation decision-making or teacher approval of student editorial content. Shares are provisional.

Students supply actual questions and constraints in s1; the institution supplies current procedure versions and the adviser supplies actual prior advice. Missing context is obtained manually; no inferred student profile or emotion analysis is used.
Try native links first. Follow-up prose, relationships, advice and actual send retain full effort. No new monitoring service or model is needed.
unknowns: Whether advice routinely requires a follow-up message
research_questions: Are the needed procedures already linked well enough that configuration adds no benefit?

already_counted.description: Actual follow-up authorship and recipient/meaning check.

incremental.description: Refresh adviser links after procedure changes.

approvals.approved_version: checked organisation advice message v1 and named recipients; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native links remove 4.5 of the provisional 15 reference hours less 0.5 upkeep. An already linked organisation has no gross saving; actual listening, advice, written follow-up and send remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compile specialised communications bibliographies for outside reading.

steps.what: Search actual catalogues and subject databases for specialised communications reading relevant to the course
Read and select appropriate specialised materials, checking relevance, level, actual existence and student access
Compile and format the bibliography from verified selected records, deduplicating entries and checking citation fields
Check the completed bibliography v1 for actual references, access links and intended course reading use
Save the exact checked specialised bibliography v1 in the same course-preparation folder

tasks.design: Configure saved subject searches and native record import in the catalogue/reference-manager environment {OTHER}, then generate citations in the required style into {DOCS}. The teacher still reads, selects and verifies actual sources and student access; no model-generated titles or invented references are needed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated catalogue searches and manual citation formatting can interrupt reading selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved searches, record import and citation styles can repeat known bibliographic operations.
tasks.still_hard: A real source may still be unsuitable for the students or inaccessible.
tasks.human_edge: Choose readings that teach the intended communications argument and viewpoint range.

ambition.what: No new course or library acquisition authority.

tasks.altitude: Less reference formatting, with reading and pedagogical selection unchanged.

reach.learn: Use stable identifiers and check access rather than trust a title string.

evidence.claim: Reference managers and catalogues can import verified bibliographic records, deduplicate and apply citation styles.

assumptions: Boundary is compiling the bibliography, including its record, not publishing it to a student course. A distinct publication needs a separate gate if added. Shares are provisional.

Catalogue or publisher records supply title, authors, date, edition, identifier, venue and access URL. The teacher supplies actual course aims and selection and manually corrects missing metadata from the real source. Every selected item must resolve to an actual source; incomplete records are not invented.
Test native import/search/style tools first. Search reduction is repeat query setup only; reading, relevance and access checks keep full effort. Same-folder save earns no saving.
unknowns: Coverage and correctness of importable metadata
research_questions: How much citation preparation is still manual after the existing tool's native features are configured?

already_counted.description: Check citation fields and duplicates during compilation.

incremental.description: Maintain saved searches and citation-style settings.

approvals.approved_version: checked specialised bibliography v1; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native saved queries remove 4.5 setup hours and citation import/formatting removes 12 hours per provisional 100 task hours, less 0.5 upkeep. Poor metadata requires more manual correction; reading and final source checks remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in student recruitment, registration and placement.

steps.what: Discuss the communications program with prospective or current students and establish actual registration or placement questions
Retrieve actual student registration status and authorised course or placement information relevant to the question
Give individual guidance, resolve permitted registration questions or prepare a placement recommendation within the teacher's actual role
Enter and check the actual participation or referral note v1, distinguishing guidance from an authorised admission, registration or placement decision
Save the exact checked participation note v1 in the same student record

tasks.design: Configure a native teacher view and linked note form in the student information system {OTHER}, showing existing registration status beside approved program references in {DOCS}. Personal recruitment and placement guidance stay human; only navigation and existing identifier re-entry shrink, and the checked note has a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participation may require switching between student status and program reference screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Native role views and linked forms can reuse existing identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: A student's aims and circumstances require personal advice; authorised enrolment and placement decisions remain with their existing owners.
tasks.human_edge: Help a student understand options without inferring suitability from a profile.

ambition.what: No new admission, registration or placement decision rights.

tasks.altitude: Less navigation and repeated note headers, with personal guidance unchanged.

reach.learn: Keep guidance distinct from authorised student status changes.

evidence.claim: Native student-system views and linked forms can reduce status navigation and identifier re-entry without making student decisions.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher participation in recruitment, registration support and placement guidance, including its actual note. Student-service decisions and official status changes are separate unchanged work with no saving credit. Shares are provisional.

Student services produces actual student id, current registration status, course and placement records; program owners supply current dates and requirements. Students supply actual preferences in conversation. The teacher manually resolves missing status or context and writes the actual note; no predicted student traits or automated ranking.

Test native role views first. The 10% note reduction is existing student/course headers only; personal guidance and substantive note content stay full. A referral send or official status commit, if performed, needs its own exact-version gate and cannot be folded into this note save.
unknowns: Actual teacher permissions and support responsibilities
Whether native views and linked note headers are already configured
research_questions: Which repeated status navigation or header entry can the installed system actually remove?

already_counted.description: Actual participation-note content and final check.

incremental.description: Maintain role-view links and note-header mapping after program changes.

approvals.approved_version: checked participation note v1; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native views remove 5 reference hours and 1.4 repeated-header hours per provisional 100 task hours, less 0.8 upkeep. An already configured student system offers little gross gain; conversations, substantive guidance and save stay full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less repeated grant, bibliography and reference preparation while teaching advice and research decisions stay human.
reach: Work with librarians and program coordinators on verified reading and student information.
skills_to_grow: Keep guidance separate from official student decisions
role.ambitious_version: A communications teacher with traceable preparation and unchanged academic and student decision authority.
